rule: Work the first HOLD stage that materially blocks release; do not spend time on deferred assurance while upstream product-definition stages are open.

stages.done_when: Canonical native filenames contain only stable identity + description; lifecycle state is metadata; no new stateful filenames.
stages.title: Identity

stages.done_when: requirements.json and parts.json are authoritative; coverage report exposes every requirement without registered evidence.
stages.title: Requirements + parts registries

stages.done_when: POST-only side effects, registered file IDs, escaped DOM rendering, one status classifier, no engineering literals in UI, reducer fixtures PASS.
stages.title: Panel trust / reducer assurance

stages.done_when: CAD occurrence/qty + parts.json attributes generate EBOM/MBOM; suppressed/non-modeled items explicit; registry→CAD props is one-way.
stages.title: Specification as graph node

stages.done_when: Critical tolerances/datums are native PMI/MBD; changing model tolerance stales tolerance-chain node automatically; MC uses only explicit distributions.
stages.title: Tolerances as model data

stages.done_when: P007 exemplar validated first; no drawing tolerance absent from model PMI; title/revision/references/PMI/visual QA pass.
stages.title: Drawing release

stages.done_when: Stable characteristic IDs link PMI, drawing balloon, inspection data and released acceptance; leak result is numeric and auto-evaluated.
stages.title: Characteristics + acceptance

stages.done_when: Qualified Windows self-hosted runner rebuilds stale CAD/FEMM nodes nightly; cloud CI handles non-CAD tests.
stages.title: Runner + nightly build
